summary: Admin file management features tested successfully. Backend: 6/6 new tests passed (100%). Frontend: All new admin UI controls verified and working correctly for admin users. Non-admin authorization confirmed via backend tests (403 errors).
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Admin can edit ALL file properties via PUT /api/admin/files/{id}
✅ Admin can delete files via DELETE /api/admin/files/{id} - also removes related approvals/notifications
✅ Admin can override department approvals via PUT /api/admin/files/{id}/approval/{approval_id}
✅ Non-admin users receive 403 Forbidden on all admin endpoints
✅ Admin UI controls (pencil, delete icons, ADMIN CONTROLS bar) visible only to admin role
✅ Admin edit modal includes all 13 editable fields (name, phone, address, description, tahsildar location, status, lock state, DC decision, DC remark, ADC remark)
✅ Status picker and location picker modals work correctly
✅ Lock toggle and DC decision chips functional
✅ Danger zone with permanent delete button present in edit modal
✅ Override button visible on each department approval for admin users
✅ All testID attributes properly implemented for admin controls
